sections.title: Visiting Madinah and Masjid an-Nabawi
sections.introduction: Visiting Madinah is not a ritual of Hajj or Umrah, but many pilgrims visit the Prophet's Mosque.

items.title: Dua when leaving home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.english: In the name of Allah. I place my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

items.title: Dua when travelling
items.arabic:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ

اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration:
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar.

Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.

Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda.

Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah.

Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahl.

Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-manzari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.
items.english:
Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.

Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, although we could not have controlled it ourselves, and surely to our Lord we will return.

O Allah, we ask You for righteousness, piety and deeds that please You during this journey.

O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance.

O Allah, You are our Companion during travel and our Guardian over our family.

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the difficulties of travel, distressing sights and a bad return concerning wealth and family.

items.title: Dua when returning from a journey
items.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li Rabbina hamidun.
items.english: We return, repenting, worshipping our Lord and praising Him.

items.title: Dua when entering Masjid al-Haram
items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration:
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah.

Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
items.english:
In the name of Allah. May peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
items.notes_en: Enter with the right foot.

items.title: Dua when leaving the mosque
items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration:
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah.

Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.english:
In the name of Allah. May peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.

items.title: Intention for Umrah
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni uridul-'umrah.
items.english: O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah.
items.notes_en:
The intention is made in the heart. No particular verbal formula is obligatory.

A person may say:

This is an explanatory wording, not a prescribed prophetic formula.

items.title: Intention for Hajj
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni uridul-hajj.
items.english: O Allah, I intend to perform Hajj.
items.notes_en: The intention is in the heart; this wording is optional.

items.title: Talbiyah
items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.english: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
items.notes_en: Authentic Sunnah.

items.title: Conditional intention when fearing an obstruction
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَحِلِّي حَيْثُ حَبَسْتَنِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma mahilli haythu habastani.
items.english: O Allah, my place of exiting Ihram is wherever You prevent me from continuing.
items.notes_en: This is for someone who fears a genuine obstacle preventing completion.

items.title: Dhikr upon seeing the Ka'bah
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
items.english: Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en:
There is no authentic, specifically prescribed dua established from the Prophet ﷺ for the first sight of the Ka'bah.

You may say:

You may also praise Allah and make your own supplication. Popular long duas circulated specifically for the first sight of the Ka'bah should not be attributed to the Prophet ﷺ without evidence.
items.classification: General Dhikr; no specific authentic first-sight dua established

items.title: Starting Tawaf at Hajar al-Aswad
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, Allahu Akbar.
items.english: In the name of Allah. Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en: The Prophet ﷺ is authentically reported to have said Takbir when reaching the Black Stone.

items.title: Dhikr during Tawaf
items.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration:
Subhanallah.

Alhamdulillah.

Allahu Akbar.

La ilaha illallah.

Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.
items.english:
There is no fixed dua assigned to each of the seven rounds. These are permissible general forms of remembrance:

Tasbih — Glory be to Allah.

Tahmid — All praise belongs to Allah.

Takbir — Allah is the Greatest.

Tahlil — There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

Istighfar — I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.

items.title: Dua between Rukn al-Yamani and Hajar al-Aswad
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
items.english: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.notes_en: Qur'anic dua recited in the Sunnah.

items.title: When reaching Rukn al-Yamani
items.english: There is no separate specific dua prescribed for this corner. Continue with the dua in section 13 as you walk towards the Black Stone.
items.notes_en: If possible, touch the Yemeni Corner with the right hand. Do not kiss it or gesture towards it when unable to touch it.
items.classification: Practical ritual instruction; no separate specific dua established

items.title: After completing Tawaf
items.arabic: وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى
items.transliteration: Wattakhidhu min maqami Ibrahima musalla.
items.english: And take the standing place of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.
items.notes_en: Pray two Rak'ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim if possible. There is no authentic fixed dua specifically prescribed immediately after completing Tawaf.
items.classification: Qur'anic instruction and practical ritual note

items.title: Upon approaching Safa for the first time
items.arabic:
إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ

أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
items.transliteration:
Innas-Safa wal-Marwata min sha'a'irillah.

Abda'u bima bada'allahu bih.
items.english:
Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

I begin with that which Allah began with.
items.notes_en:
Recite the Qur'anic verse:

Then say: “I begin with that which Allah began with.”

items.title: Dhikr at Safa
items.arabic:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
items.transliteration:
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar.

La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
items.english:
Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, helped His servant and defeated the confederate forces alone.
items.notes_en: Face the Ka'bah, raise your hands and recite. The Prophet ﷺ recited this remembrance three times, making supplication between the repetitions.

items.title: Dua at Safa
items.english: There is no additional fixed wording that must be recited. After the remembrance in section 17, make supplication. Repeat the remembrance and supplication as narrated.
items.classification: Personal supplication; no additional fixed wording

items.title: Dhikr while walking from Safa to Marwah
items.english: There is no specific fixed dua for the walking stretches. Continue with general Dhikr or Qur'an recitation.
items.classification: General Dhikr or Qur'an recitation; no fixed dua

items.title: Dhikr at Marwah
items.arabic:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
items.transliteration:
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar.

La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

La ilaha illallahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaba wahdah.
items.english:
Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, helped His servant and defeated the confederate forces alone.
items.notes_en: When reaching Marwah, face the Ka'bah and recite the same remembrance as at Safa.

items.title: Completing the seven rounds of Sa'i
items.english: There is no established specific completion dua.
items.notes_en:
The seven journeys are counted as:

Safa to Marwah: 1

Marwah to Safa: 2

Safa to Marwah: 3

Marwah to Safa: 4

Safa to Marwah: 5

Marwah to Safa: 6

Safa to Marwah: 7
items.classification: Practical ritual instruction; no specific completion dua established

items.title: After Sa'i and before shaving or trimming hair
items.english: There is no specific authentic prophetic dua prescribed for this exact moment.
items.classification: Explanatory note; no specific prophetic dua established

items.title: After shaving or trimming hair
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lil-muhalliqin.
items.english: O Allah, forgive those who shave their heads.
items.notes_en:
There is no established special dua that the pilgrim must recite after cutting their hair.

The Prophet ﷺ supplicated this. He repeated this supplication and then included those who shortened their hair.

items.title: Talbiyah while travelling to Mina
items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.english: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

items.title: Upon reaching Mina
items.english: There is no authentic specific entry dua for Mina.
items.notes_en: Continue Talbiyah, Takbir, Tahlil and other established Dhikr.
items.classification: Explanatory note and established general Dhikr

items.title: Upon reaching the plain of Arafah
items.english: There is no authentic specific dua for entering Arafah.
items.notes_en: Continue Talbiyah and remembrance.

items.title: At Jabal al-Rahmah (Mount of Mercy)
items.english: There is no authentic specific dua for climbing Jabal al-Rahmah, touching its stones, standing on its summit or facing its pillar. There is also no special dua established specifically for the mountain itself.
items.notes_en: The Sunnah is to make supplication throughout the standing at Arafah, wherever one is within the boundaries of Arafah.

items.title: The best Dhikr of the Day of Arafah
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.english: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
items.notes_en: Reported in Hadith.

items.title: Dua for the Day of Arafah
items.arabic:
خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ، وَخَيْرُ مَا قُلْتُ أَنَا وَالنَّبِيُّونَ مِنْ قَبْلِي:

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration:
Khayrud-du'a'i du'a'u yawmi 'Arafah, wa khayru ma qultu ana wan-nabiyyuna min qabli:

La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.english:
The best supplication is the supplication made on the Day of Arafah, and the best thing that I and the Prophets before me have said is:

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
items.notes_en:
The following is the reported statement about the best supplication of the Day of Arafah.

The report's grading has been discussed by hadith scholars.
items.classification: Reported supplication; grading discussed by hadith scholars

items.title: Dhikr and supplication throughout Arafah
items.english: Repeat the remembrance in section 28, along with Talbiyah, Takbir and personal supplication.
items.notes_en: There is no fixed set of Arabic duas assigned to particular hours of Arafah.
items.classification: General remembrance and personal supplication; no fixed hourly duas

items.title: Talbiyah while leaving Arafah
items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.english: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
items.notes_en: There is no separate prescribed departure dua for Arafah.

items.title: Upon reaching Muzdalifah
items.english: There is no specific authentic entry dua.
items.classification: Explanatory note; no specific authentic dua established

items.title: After Fajr at al-Mash'ar al-Haram
items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.english: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone. He has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
items.notes_en: Face the Qiblah, praise Allah, recite Takbir and Tahlil, and make supplication. Continue remembrance and supplication until the sky becomes bright, before sunrise.

items.title: Leaving Muzdalifah for Mina
items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.english: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
items.notes_en: Continue Talbiyah.

items.title: Talbiyah before stoning Jamarat al-Aqabah
items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk. Innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
items.english: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am; You have no partner; here I am. Surely all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
items.notes_en: Continue Talbiyah until beginning the stoning of Jamarat al-Aqabah.

items.title: Takbir when throwing pebbles at Jamarat al-Aqabah
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
items.english: Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en: Say this with each of the seven pebbles. There is no separate prescribed dua after this particular Jamarah.

items.title: Dua during animal sacrifice (Hady)
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, wallahu Akbar.
items.english: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

items.title: Shaving or shortening the hair
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُحَلِّقِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lil-muhalliqin.
items.english: O Allah, forgive those who shave their heads.
items.notes_en: The Prophet ﷺ made this supplication. He repeated it and then supplicated for those who shortened their hair.

items.title: At Hajar al-Aswad
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, Allahu Akbar.
items.english: In the name of Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

items.title: During the seven rounds
items.arabic:
اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
items.transliteration:
Allahu Akbar.

Alhamdulillah.

Subhanallah.

La ilaha illallah.
items.english:
Use the same established and permissible remembrances as in the first Tawaf:

Takbir: Allah is the Greatest.

Tahmid: All praise belongs to Allah.

Tasbih: Glory be to Allah.

Tahlil: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

items.title: Between Rukn al-Yamani and Hajar al-Aswad
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
items.english: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.title: After Tawaf al-Ifadah
items.english: There is no separate authentic completion dua for Tawaf al-Ifadah.
items.notes_en: Pray two Rak'ahs if possible, following the same practice as the earlier Tawaf.
items.classification: Practical ritual instruction; no separate completion dua established

items.title: First Jamarah – Small Jamarah
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
items.english: Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en: Throw seven pebbles, saying Takbir with each pebble. After throwing the seven pebbles, move aside, face the Qiblah if possible, raise your hands and make supplication. There is no fixed wording for this supplication.

items.title: Second Jamarah – Middle Jamarah
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
items.english: Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en: Throw seven pebbles. After throwing the seven pebbles, move aside and make supplication. There is no fixed wording for this supplication.

items.title: Third Jamarah – Jamarat al-Aqabah
items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.
items.english: Allah is the Greatest.
items.notes_en: Throw seven pebbles. Do not stop for the extended supplication after this Jamarah. There is no prescribed additional dua after it. Reference for the three Jamarat practices: Sahih al-Bukhari 1751.

items.title: Starting the Farewell Tawaf
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi, Allahu Akbar.
items.english: In the name of Allah. Allah is the Greatest.

items.title: During the Farewell Tawaf
items.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
items.transliteration:
Subhanallah.

Alhamdulillah.

Allahu Akbar.

La ilaha illallah.
items.english:
Glory be to Allah.

All praise belongs to AAllah.

All praise belongs to Allah.

Allah is the Greatest.

There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
items.notes_en: The supplied English includes an apparent duplicated or mistyped line (“All praise belongs to AAllah.”). It is preserved in the source wording and flagged for human review, not silently corrected.
items.classification: General permissible Dhikr; source wording flagged for review

items.title: Between Rukn al-Yamani and Hajar al-Aswad
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
items.english: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.title: Leaving Masjid al-Haram
items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration:
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah.

Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.english:
In the name of Allah. May peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.

items.title: Entering Masjid an-Nabawi
items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration:
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah.

Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
items.english:
In the name of Allah. May peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
items.notes_en: Visiting Madinah is not a ritual of Hajj or Umrah, but many pilgrims visit the Prophet's Mosque.

items.title: Sending Salam to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu 'alayka ya Rasulallah wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
items.english: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
items.notes_en: This is a permissible wording of greeting, not a compulsory fixed formula.

items.title: Sending Salam to Abu Bakr رضي الله عنه
items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu 'alayka ya Aba Bakris-Siddiq, wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
items.english: Peace be upon you, O Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

items.title: Sending Salam to Umar ibn al-Khattab رضي الله عنه
items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عُمَرُ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
items.transliteration: As-salamu 'alayka ya Umar ibn al-Khattab, wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
items.english: Peace be upon you, O Umar ibn al-Khattab, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

items.title: Leaving Masjid an-Nabawi
items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration:
Bismillah, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala Rasulillah.

Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.english:
In the name of Allah. May peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah.

O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
